title: Our Future Health — Imputed genotype data — Sample QC metrics
description: Array of Our Future Health genetic data records. One element is one participant's sample quality-control record from the imputed genotype data (file ofh_imputed_sample_qc_metrics.v6.tsv).
$comment: Describes the columns of the source file as a table of rows; the files themselves are TSV, text or VCF (D124). A value absent in the source is -998 (the string "-998" for text), D021. Cross-table links to participant.PID cannot be enforced (D102).
